label: sad wander
note: Walks around the colony doing nothing; ends after the minimum once mood is above the break level.

label: food binge
note: Goes to the food and eats well past full; works only if there is food (C14).

label: hide in room
note: Goes to their bedroom, or any indoor cell, and stays.

label: tantrum
note: Walks to something nearby and smashes it, then another; takes only objects, not pawns.

label: sad wander
note: Like the minor wander but longer.

label: insulting spree
note: Insults three colonists in turn (C20), then ends.

label: berserk
note: Attacks the nearest pawn or thing in reach; fights until downed or the break ends (F8).

label: give up and leave
note: Walks to the map edge and leaves for good, with anything carried; a day's warning message.

label: fire-starting spree
note: Needs fire (E4): lights fires near flammable things.
